# HYG 4.1 bright stars

Data by David Nash / Astronexus, incorporating Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star and Gliese catalog data. Source: https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database/tree/main/hyg . Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . This derived subset remains CC BY-SA 4.0; see LICENSE and ../astronomy-dependencies.json.

Nodevision selected 5,070 non-Solar entries of visual magnitude <= 6. Coordinates retain upstream J2000 RA in hours and declination in degrees. Proper motions are omitted. Rebuild using scripts/build-bright-star-catalog.py with the upstream CSV. No runtime web request is required.
